recognize_zh: 這是 HBB 基因的 Sanger 定序圖（非形態圖）：前段單一清楚峰值，約在 AGG（codon 40）之後開始出現重疊的雙峰，代表此處起有異型合子的插入或缺失造成讀框位移，常見如 codon 41/42（-TTCT）。
features: Abrupt onset of overlapping double peaks immediately downstream, persisting along the read
Pattern indicates a heterozygous small insertion/deletion causing frameshift, plausibly codons 41/42 (-TTCT)
Base calls after the transition are unreliable because two sequences are superimposed
describe_en: This is a Sanger sequencing electropherogram of the beta-globin (HBB) gene rather than a morphologic image. The trace shows clean single peaks through the sequence corresponding to approximately codons 36-40, followed by an abrupt transition to overlapping double peaks that persist downstream. This pattern indicates a heterozygous small insertion or deletion producing a frameshift, with the location consistent with the common codons 41/42 (-TTCT) beta-zero mutation, although exact nomenclature requires reverse-strand sequencing or deconvolution. A beta-thalassemia major phenotype would additionally require a second pathogenic HBB allele (compound heterozygosity) on the other chromosome.

ddx.dx: Heterozygous point mutation (e.g., IVS-II-654 C>T, codon 17 A>T)
ddx.vs: A single-nucleotide variant produces one isolated double peak with clean sequence on either side, not a persistent run of superimposed peaks.

ddx.dx: Sequencing artifact from poor template or dye blobs
ddx.vs: Artifacts give noisy low peaks or broad blobs throughout, whereas a true indel shows a sharp, reproducible transition point confirmed on the reverse strand.
A homozygous indel yields clean single peaks of the altered sequence rather than overlapping double peaks.
